landing.partnerTitle: Help keep public places clean — and accountable.
landing.partnerIntro: Drosia helps people report litter in under a minute — no account, no data selling. We're looking for partners who believe clean streets, beaches and neighbourhoods are part of how a place feels and welcomes people.
landing.pHotelV: Show guests your destination cares about clean beaches, streets and neighbourhoods.
landing.pMuniV: Use open reports to spot hotspots, respond transparently and build trust.
landing.pNgoV: Turn community concern into visible action, local data and stronger campaigns.
landing.partnerNote: No sponsorship packages. No pressure — just a conversation.

support.heroTitle: Cleaner places need more than good intentions.
support.heroP1: Every day, people walk past litter in streets, parks, beaches, hiking paths and neighbourhoods. Most of them care — but reporting it is often slow, unclear or invisible.
support.heroP2: Drosia makes it simple: take a photo, send a report, and help create a public signal that shows where action is needed.
support.heroP3: We want to keep Drosia independent, ad-free and respectful of people's data. That's why we're looking for supporters who share the same goal: cleaner public spaces and more transparent local action.
support.why1Body: Individual complaints often disappear into inboxes. Drosia turns reports into a shared map, making problem areas easier to understand and harder to ignore.
support.why2Title: You support civic action without barriers
support.why2Body: No account. No complicated process. No data selling. Anyone can report a problem in less than a minute.
support.why3Title: You connect your organisation with a visible mission
support.why3Body: Supporting Drosia is a practical way to show that your organisation cares about the places where people live, work, travel and spend time outdoors.
support.whoHotelBody: Clean surroundings are part of the guest experience. Supporting Drosia helps protect the beaches, streets, viewpoints, trails and neighbourhoods that make a destination worth visiting.
support.whoMuniBody: Drosia can help you see where residents are reporting litter, understand recurring hotspots and show that public feedback leads to action.
support.whoNgoBody: Use Drosia as a simple tool for awareness campaigns, clean-up initiatives, local reporting drives and community engagement.
support.howBody: Support doesn't have to mean one fixed package. Depending on your organisation, it could mean helping cover running costs, sharing Drosia with your community, using it in a local campaign, connecting us with municipalities, or supporting reporting in a specific area.
support.howGoal: The goal is simple: help more people report litter easily, and help more places respond.
support.formIntro: Tell us a little about who you are and which places you care about. We'll read your message and get back to you personally.
support.formNote: No pressure. No fixed package. Just a first conversation about cleaner public spaces and how Drosia could help.
